cues.zh: 嗨，我想做一个全桥整流器。没错，不是那种简单的单二极管整流器。
cues.en: Hi, I want to make a FULL BRIDGE RECTIFIER That's right, It's not a dumb single diode rectifier.

cues.zh: 是全桥的
cues.en: It's a FUULL BRIDGE

cues.zh: 什么是整流器？它基本上就是把交流电（AC）转换成直流电（DC）
cues.en: What is a rectifier? It basically converts AC (alternating current) into DC (direct current)

cues.zh: 全桥基本上就是由四个二极管按这种排列组成的
cues.en: Full Bridge is basically made of four diodes in this arrangement

cues.zh: 整流也可以用单个二极管完成。什么是二极管？
cues.en: The rectification can also be done with a single diode. What's a diode?

cues.zh: 它就像一个电气单向阀，只允许电流朝一个方向流动
cues.en: It's like an electrical check valve that allows current in One Direction

cues.zh: 但阻止它回流。如果你给单个二极管提供交流电压，它输出的是
cues.en: But blocks it from going back. If you provide an AC voltage to a single diode it outputs

cues.zh: 波形的正半周。如果在它的输出端加一个电容，它就能把电压保持在接近波峰的位置，作为直流电
cues.en: the positive half of the wave. If you put a capacitor at its output, it holds the voltage close to the peak of the wave as DC

cues.zh: 现在，全桥整流器把正半周和负半周都转换成输出端的正向波峰，在输出端加一个电容
cues.en: Now, a full bridge rectifier converts both the positive and negative peaks into positive bumps at the output, adding a capacitor at the output

cues.zh: 又能把它转换成直流电。一般来说，单个二极管用于低功率
cues.en: converts it into DC again. Generally a single Diode is used for low-power

cues.zh: 整流以及直流反接保护。但全桥整流器用于高功率
cues.en: rectification as well as DC reverse polarity protection. But a full bridge rectifier is used for high-power

cues.zh: 整流以及反接保护。
cues.en: rectification as well as reverse polarity protection.

cues.zh: 这是我的设计。接入
cues.en: Now here's my design. When connected to

cues.zh: 120V 交流电时，它的空载输出设计接近 170V 直流电，最大能带动 10A 的负载。
cues.en: 120 volt AC line it is designed to output close to 170 volt DC at no load, and capable of driving 10 amps maximum load.

cues.zh: 所以输入端自然加了个 10A 的保险丝做保护。接着是二极管整流桥。
cues.en: So, naturally there is a 10 amp fuse at the input for protection. Then the diode bridge.

cues.zh: 加上的电感有助于纹波滤波。这就是我做出来的东西。它个头相当大，当然输出功率能超过 1000 瓦
cues.en: The added inductor helps with ripple filtering. Here's what I've made. It is pretty huge which of course can output over a thousand watts

cues.zh: 可不像你手里那些顶多输出 20 瓦的弱鸡充电头。
cues.en: Unlike your puny wall adapter that can do 20 watts at best.

cues.zh: 现在插上电试试。我这电路连着几根散线，我直接把它们插进电源插座里
cues.en: Now let's plug it in. I have some loose wires connected to my circuit which I will stick into the power plug

cues.zh: 显而易见，我完全没把安全当回事，大家千万别学我。
cues.en: As you can clearly see I have no regard for safety, don't be like that.

cues.zh: 看吧，这电又不会飞出来电你
cues.en: See, this electricity is not going to jump at you

cues.zh: 因为它的电压还没高到能击穿空气跳火的程度，只有直接摸到火线才会被电到。
cues.en: Because it doesn't have high enough voltage to jump, the only way you would get hurt is by touching live wire.

cues.zh: 正确绝缘你的电路，戴上安全手套，别赤手空拳碰那玩意儿。
cues.en: So insulate your circuit properly, wear safety gloves and don't touch sh** with your bare hands.

cues.zh: 赤手空拳[熊掌]！你们为什么管它叫赤手空拳[熊掌]？
cues.en: Bare [bear] hands faaaaah! Why do you call them bare [bear] hands?

cues.zh: 我要用赤手空拳去碰170伏直流电。
cues.en: I'm going to touch 170 volt DC with my bare hands.

cues.zh: 输出端有166伏，现在我把手指搭在输出上。
cues.en: There is 166 volts on the output, now I'll put my finger across the output

cues.zh: 看，我几乎感觉不到，直流电比交流电危险小多了。
cues.en: See I can barely feel it, DC is much less dangerous than AC

cues.zh: 几乎[小熊]？你们语言里怎么老跟熊过不去。我今天感觉好壮[小熊]啊，嗷嗷嗷！
cues.en: Barely [Bearly], what's up with bears in your language. I feel so Burly [bearly] today RRRRR!

cues.zh: 桥式整流器广泛用于交流转直流转换器。
cues.en: Bridge rectifiers are widely used in AC to DC Converters.

cues.zh: 据我所知，你们所有的墙插适配器里都有这种电路。
cues.en: As far as I know all your wall adapters contain one of these circuits.

cues.zh: 现在我来测一些波形。我把探头接到了输出线上。
cues.en: Now I will measure some waveforms. I connected the probe to my output lines

cues.zh: 把电路接到这个插线板上，现在我把插线板打开。
cues.en: Connected my circuit to this power bar and now I will turn the power bar on

cues.zh: 我去！{哔}！
cues.en: SHI*! {BLEEP}!

cues.zh: 我的保险丝刚烧了。
cues.en: My fuse just blew up.

cues.zh: 我吃了大亏才意识到，探针的地线其实通过示波器跟电源插头的地线短接了。
cues.en: Something I realized the hard way is that the ground of the probe is actually shorted to the earth of the power plug through the Scope.

cues.zh: 所以问题是，当我把地线接到桥式整流的负输出端时，
cues.en: So what happens is that when I connect the ground to the negative output of the bridge,

cues.zh: 它会在交流电的每个负半周把火线短接到地，这就是为什么要有保险丝，免得真烧起来。
cues.en: it shorts the live wire to earth every negative cycle of the AC and that's why we have fuses to avoid exciting fires

cues.zh: 现在我用这种叫 Kapton 胶带的东西把电源线的地线绝缘起来。
cues.en: Now I'm using this tape called Kapton Tape to insulate the earth of the power cord.

cues.zh: 还是同样的接法，接上探针后我把插排打开。
cues.en: I have the same setup again, and with the probe connected I (will) turn the power bar on.

cues.zh: *咔哒*
cues.en: *click*

cues.zh: 现在安全了。你可以看到示波器上输出电压大约 170 伏。
cues.en: We are safe now. As you can see on the scope the output voltage is around 170 volts.

cues.zh: 现在我想用我的 100 欧姆电阻接到输出端，看看波形会怎么变化。
cues.en: Now I'd like to use my 100 Ohm resistor and connect it to the output to see how the waveform changes.

cues.zh: 简单算一下，170 伏加在 100 欧姆上会产生 300 瓦的功率
cues.en: A quick calculation shows having 170 volts across 100 Ohm generates 300 watts of power

cues.zh: 就像手指间夹了个 300 瓦的灯泡，很快就会烫伤皮肤。现在我用钳子夹住这个电阻
cues.en: It's like having a 300 watt lamp between your fingers. It burns your skin very quickly. Now I (am going to) use pliers to hold the resistor

cues.zh: 看，输出电压下降了，但纹波很小，因为滤波很充分
cues.en: See the output voltage drops, but with very small ripples because there is a lot of filtering

cues.zh: 哇，我刚才一直拿着它……
cues.en: Wow, I was holding that...

cues.zh: 我让它冷却了一会儿，结果，我去！
cues.en: I let it cool down for a while, and SH**!

cues.zh: 陶瓷芯要很久才能冷却下来，现在你能看到这个电阻是用电阻丝
cues.en: The ceramic core takes a long time to cool down and now you can see that the resistor is made of resistive wires

cues.zh: 绕在陶瓷芯上做成的
cues.en: wound around the ceramic core

cues.zh: 总之，这个电源最终会给我的大功率特斯拉线圈驱动电路供电。
cues.en: Anywho this power supply will eventually feed my high-power Tesla Coil Driver Circuit.

cues.zh: 哎哟！
cues.en: OW!

cues.zh: 记住，这类电路即使拔掉插头，电容仍会长时间储存电荷，所以一定要用电阻给它们放电。
cues.en: Remember in such circuits although unplugged the capacitors hold a charge for a long period of time so always discharge them with some resistor.
